thread:
maria.dev: quick handoff — I'm about to land a small PR that tweaks the streaming + paginate examples across py/ts/go. Please peek when you can, I changed the retry backoff and fixed a subtle cursor bug in the Go iterator.
kevin.docs: thanks — pinged. can you summarize the user-visible change? will tests need updates? :eyes:
maria.dev: oops typo, meant maria.dev. summary: python example now uses `with client.stream(...) as s:` pattern instead of the old `.stream()` call that returned a raw generator. TS snippet swaps to the new AsyncIterable pattern from the previous callback approach. Go fixes the resume token handling in the pagination example (we were accidentally reusing the same buffer and losing state).
sanjay: can you paste the small diffs or the failing snippet? i can run the examples locally.
maria.dev: sure — minimal changes, gist here: https://gist.github.com/redwood/dev-snippet-fix (private). quick snippets: 
```py
# old
for chunk in client.stream("chat.completions", prompt):
    print(chunk)
# new
with client.stream("chat.completions", prompt) as stream:
    for chunk in stream:
        print(chunk)
```
```ts
// use AsyncIterable for better backpressure
for await (const event of client.streamResponses(req)) {
  if (event.type === 'delta') console.log(event.delta)
}
```
```go
// pagination resume fix: clone token per request
tok := pagination.Clone(resumeToken)
for {
  page, err := client.List(ctx, tok)
  if err != nil { return err }
  tok = page.NextToken
}
```
olivia-eng: small ask: can we add a short note about how retries interact with streaming (e.g. idempotency and where to resume) — docs peeps will like a one-liner.
maria.dev: good call. added a note inline: "Retries should be configured to avoid retransmitting user input; for streaming, prefer connection-level retries and rely on resume tokens for data-level continuation."
kevin.docs: CI flagged a python lint error in the example (unused import) — i pushed a tiny fix to your branch. CI bot: `pytest examples/` failed on `test_streaming_examples.py` — exception: "generator object has no attribute __enter__" — indicates some examples still use the old pattern.
maria.dev: ah, i missed one reference in docs/quickstart/streaming.md line ~42, will patch now.
sanjay: running the examples locally now, i'll report if anything else breaks.
tim: for visibility — if this lands before the SDK release, we should backport the snippet fixes to the 0.9.x docs branch.
maria.dev: agreed, i'll open a backport PR after merge. cc @kevin.docs for review + merge rights. :thumbsup:
kevin.docs: review done, left one nit about wording around "resume token" vs "continuation token" — prefer "resume token" consistently.
maria.dev: updated. re-ran examples, all good locally. will wait for CI green then merge.
